item.title: [13 Nov] Live: Breaking an AI-Built App in 30 Minutes — for CTOs and Founders
item.description:
When: Friday 13 November 2026, 13:30
Where: Online
Source: Meetup — Thessaloniki tech · Meetup

Your team releases faster with AI coding tools. But who checks what those tools leave behind? In this 45-minute online session I will take an app built with AI tools and break it live, step by step. You will see how API keys are pulled out of an installed app, how one user can read another user's data through a badly configured backend, and what an attacker finds in data stored on the phone. Then we turn it round: five checks you can ask your team to run on Monday, and the questions to ask before you sign off the next release. WHO IT IS FOR CTOs, technical founders, heads of engineering and product leads who are accountable for releases and customer data. This is not a beginner's coding clas…
